name: NPM Package Distribution
description: Package FADE CLI as an NPM package for easier installation and updates. Instead of downloading a shell script manually, users can run 'npx fade-cli' or 'npm install -g fade-cli'. Inspired by GSD's 'npx get-shit-done-cc' which dramatically simplifies adoption.

userStories.title: NPM package structure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want FADE packaged as a valid NPM package so it can be published to npmjs.com
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with name, version, description, bin, repository fields
Package name is 'fade-cli' (or similar available name)
bin field points to the fade shell script
files field includes only necessary files (bin/, prompts, templates)
License field matches LICENSE file

userStories.title: npx execution
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to run 'npx fade-cli init' without installing anything globally
acceptanceCriteria: npx fade-cli runs the CLI without global install
All fade commands work via npx (init, run, status, etc.)
First run downloads package, subsequent runs use cache
Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows (via WSL/Git Bash)

userStories.title: Global installation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to install FADE globally so I can run 'fade' directly
acceptanceCriteria: npm install -g fade-cli works
After install, 'fade' command is available in PATH
Global install doesn't conflict with local installs
Uninstall works: npm uninstall -g fade-cli

userStories.title: Version management via npm
userStories.description: As a developer, I want npm update to update FADE so I don't need 'fade update'
acceptanceCriteria: npm update -g fade-cli updates to latest version
npx fade-cli@latest always runs latest version
Version in package.json matches FADE_VERSION in script
fade version shows npm package version

userStories.title: Preserve fade update for artifacts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want 'fade update' to still update prompt.md and standards even when using npm
acceptanceCriteria: fade update still updates local prompt.md from latest template
fade update still syncs standards/ folder
fade update --check still works for artifact version checking
npm handles CLI binary, fade update handles project artifacts

userStories.title: Documentation for npm installation
userStories.description: As a new user, I want clear docs on how to install and use FADE via npm
acceptanceCriteria: README.md has Installation section with npm commands
Shows both npx (no install) and global install options
Documents upgrade path: npx fade-cli@latest or npm update -g
Notes that fade update is still needed for project artifact updates

technicalNotes.packageName: Check npm registry for availability. Options: fade-cli, fade-dev, fade-framework
technicalNotes.binWrapper: May need a small node wrapper that calls the shell script, or convert entire CLI to node
technicalNotes.windowsSupport: Shell script works in Git Bash/WSL. Could add .cmd wrapper for native Windows later.
technicalNotes.publishWorkflow: Add GitHub Action to publish to npm on release tag
technicalNotes.gsdComparison: GSD uses npx get-shit-done-cc with interactive installer. FADE can start simpler - just the CLI, no installer wizard.
